findings.text: Global eviction hook that produces a shadow handle for a folio under reclaim. It checks for exclusive locked and unreferenced state and when multigenerational mode is active it delegates elsewhere while otherwise it builds a compact value from control group identity and node identity and aged clock and history flags.

Global helper that chooses a demotion destination for a source node under an allowed mask. It reports absence when demotion is disabled and otherwise prefers configured choices intersected with allowed while falling back to a closest choice when none survive.

Global node ordering helper that records each choice in a caller supplied used mask. It favors the local memory endowed node when unused and otherwise evaluates remaining memory nodes by a distance derived score adjusted for identifier order and processor presence and load.

Global statistic reader for per control group per node counters. When control groups are disabled it consults node wide state and otherwise it reads an indexed cached counter from the enclosing per node structure with guards for unknown indexes and negative values.

Global size helper that sums one recency list across managed zones up to a reclaim bound. It aggregates either control group zoned counters or zone counters depending on whether control groups are enabled.

Shadow value construction applies a different mask for file versus anonymous kinds and then folds in control group identity and node identity and history indication through successive shift and combine steps to yield an encoded small integer handle.

Classic eviction path requires the folio to be off recency structures and without extra references and held locked. It advances the nonresident age of the relevant control group node vector by folio size and buckets the observed age by kind before packing.

Two build variants exist for multigenerational eviction. One yields absence unconditionally while the other derives a token from minimum sequence and reference history and charges evicted amount to a history by kind by tier counter before packing. A compile time width check guards the bit layout.

Reference classification yields one of three outcomes called activate and keep and reclaim. Locked mappings and strongly referenced or executable file cases activate while contention and first touch mapped cases keep and unreferenced cases reclaim. Multigenerational mode short circuits to reclaim when no table reference exists and otherwise defers to a reference updater to choose between activate and keep.

Two variants exist for reference state update. One always declines promotion while the other promotes executable file folios on first use and marks initial reference without promotion and on later accesses either raises history indication for multiply referenced folios or records a generic access and requests activation.

Reclaim dirty and writeback determination treats anonymous and lazy free folios as clean and not under writeback to avoid stalling. File folios default to flag derived values refreshed through filesystem supplied verification only when private state is present and a mapping with such an operation exists.

Demotion of a folio batch returns zero without action when input is empty or when allowed targets filtered by node and control group constraints are empty or when no lower tier target exists. Otherwise it migrates asynchronously toward one chosen target with movable high user allocation that forbids reclaim and allocation fallback while ignoring processor set and policy placement.

Demotion target choice intersects configured preferred nodes with the caller mask under read side protection and selects randomly among survivors. When none survive it inverts the allowed mask and asks for the closest unmarked node.

Node scoring adds a penalty when candidate identifier precedes the source and a larger penalty when the candidate hosts processors and then scales by maximum node count and adds a load term. The smallest score wins and is marked used while absence is reported when no candidate remains.

Filesystem entry permission is granted whenever the allocation mask allows filesystem activity. Swap cached folios may also proceed with only input output permission unless their swap backend declares a no filesystem input output requirement.

Isolation pressure check exempts the background reclaimer and configurations where writeback throttling is not usable. Otherwise it contrasts isolated against inactive counts of the requested file versus anonymous kind while shrinking the inactive allowance for reclaimers with filesystem and input output capability and it wakes throttled waiters when pressure is not excessive.

When every taken folio was dirty but not queued this path nudges flushers and conditionally throttles for writeback when throttling state is not usable. It unconditionally folds dirty and congested and writeback and immediate and taken tallies into the scan control accumulators.

Activity balance test derives a ratio from total list size in gigabytes through an integer square root scaled function with a floor of one and then reports scarcity when inactive scaled by that ratio falls below active.

Scan distribution first resolves an overall balance among equal and fractional and file only and anonymous only modes based on proactive anonymous only requests and swap availability and control group swappiness and out of memory priority and tiny file cache and trim mode. Per list targets start from reclaim eligible sizes and undergo protection scaling and priority shifting with a floor for offline groups and then are adjusted per the chosen balance.
Swappiness resolution prefers an explicit proactive override when proactive reclaim supplies one and otherwise it uses the control group configured value.

Fractional pressure assigns anonymous and file shares inversely to their refault derived costs blended with swappiness and its complement with added constants guaranteeing each kind retains at least roughly a third of influence before swappiness weighting.

Protection scaling reduces a scan target in proportion to the share of usage covered by low or minimum guarantees while skipping low protected groups on the first pass while recording that a skip occurred and using hard minimum on later passes and flooring protected scans to a cluster sized minimum to preserve forward progress.
Anonymous aging is considered useful whenever swap space exists and without swap it is useful only when the node and control group permit demotion.

Multigenerational vector shrinking drains pending additions and establishes a plug and a walk context for the current reclaimer and attempts vector shrinking with rotation of young control group state on success and then clears the walk context and releases the plug. Walk setup reuses the background reclaimer node context or allocates for proactive contexts while teardown validates empty progress and frees non background contexts.
Swap cache deletion helper for a folio performs no observable action in the routed fragment. It accepts cluster and folio and entry and shadow inputs and returns without effect.
Statistic reader clamps negative cached values to zero on multiprocessor builds and warns once on unmapped statistic indexes.

Read side critical sections protect control group and generation state during multigenerational shadow creation and preferred demotion set sampling. Both acquire shared read protection and dereference the protected structures and then release before packing or selecting results.

Observed scan control state includes target control group and proactive mode and optional swappiness override and swap permission and priority and file tiny and trim hints and reclaim index and allocation mask and low reclaim and skip markers and anonymous and file cost inputs and dirty and congested and writeback and immediate and taken accumulators and write and unmap permissions.

Observed reclaim structures include a per vector nonresident age counter and per vector generation state with minimum sequences and evicted tallies indexed by history kind and tier and per node per control group cached statistics and a migration control bundle carrying allocation mask and node mask pointer and reason and target node.

Several paths dereference optional operations or mappings only after explicit presence checks. Filesystem dirty verification requires both a mapping and its verification operation while filesystem entry for swap cache inspects backend flags through swap metadata and demotion proceeds only after allowed mask and target validation. Missing those guards would risk use of a missing pointer or migration to an invalid node.

Reclaim uses named outcome sets for reference handling and scan balancing and workingset kinds and zone list bases plus sentinel node absence and demotion and migration reasons. Exact numeric encodings are not visible in these fragments.
